# dagr repository

> Dagr is a programmable monorepo build system. This repository contains the execution engine and independently consumable recipes.

## Areas

- [Engine](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/tree/main/engine): CLI, graph loading, execution, Docker integration, mounts, docs, and examples.
- [Reusable recipes](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/tree/main/recipes): TypeScript build stack, RDK calculation primitive, recipe tests, mounting, and publication.

## Documentation

- [Engine LLM index](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/blob/main/engine/docs/llms.txt)

- [Repository README](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/blob/main/README.md)
